title: EOS EngineeringItem
description: Stable, repeatably specifiable engineering item across governed technical releases; not a physical piece or a release.

id.description: Stable item identity; not a drawing or external part number.

schemaVersion.description: EOS schema version, not an engineering release.

recordVersion.description: EOS record version, not an engineering release.

revision.description: EOS record revision, not a drawing issue.

status.description: Record lifecycle, not manufacturing or release status.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp, not release effectivity.

createdBy.description: Record creator, not technical release authority.

updatedAt.description: Record update timestamp, not release date.

updatedBy.description: Last record editor, not release authority.

sourceLinks.description: Evidence for stable identity and naming, not technical requirements or interchangeability.

changeSummary.description: Summary of record changes, not a release history.

name.description: Human-readable name, not an identity key.

classifications.description: Stable item classifications, not variant identity or requirements.
